page0.text:
I surpass my limits.
I'm going to Project a weapon to stop Saber while maintaining the Projection I made for Rider.

page1.text:
...
I lose my calm.
My thoughts go white-hot and exceed the speed of light.
The objective and subjective are stripped away. Unknown knowledge dominates me.

page2.text:
"Trace, fractal. (Project heavy weapon.)"
I endlessly reduce, endlessly expand, endlessly grow.
Fantasy becomes chaos with laws. That which came from nothingness no longer comes from nothingness, and many similarities arise through its expansion.

page3.text: "My bones twist and pierce. (I am the bone of my sword.)"

page4.text: I instantly Project a sword and ready it.

page6.text:
I don't need to aim.
I've already imagined it striking home, so this arrow will absolutely hit Saber.

page7.text:
"Geegh, zhh....!!!"
I bre—.
I'm—that something irrepla—is broken.

page8.text:
I view the result with my destroyed left eye.
Rider has retreated from Saber.
Saber repels my loosed spiral sword and plants her feet instead of pursuing Rider.
Only two seconds have passed.
But it's more than enough time for Rider.

page9.text:
"A Noble Phantasm!"
Fifty meters separate them.
Seeing the distance between them, Saber instantly divines Rider's intent.
She only has one way to counter it.
She'll answer Rider's ultimate attack with her own.

page10.text:
There's a torrent of dark light.
The wind coils, and Saber's sword glows red-hot.
The comet will likely attack in one second.
She deploys her strongest Noble Phantasm to cleave through Rider's pure-white light.

page11.text:
"SABER!!!"
Rider shifts her posture.
The summoning circle is complete.
A giant red eyeball appears in front of her.

page12.text:
"Come at me, Rider!"
Saber shifts her blade sideways.
Starlight coalesces and rotates, achieving criticality.
The black sun grasps that flare in both hands.

page13.text:
"BELLERO..."
Rider chants its True Name.
She is instantly enveloped in white.

page14.text:
"EX..."
Saber unveils its True Name.
Her sword blazes into black fire.

page15.text:
"...PHON!!!"
"...CALIBUR!!!"
Two rays of light flood the chamber, struggling for dominance!

page16.text:
Time stops for an instant.
Shirou Emiya accelerates his inner world, disguising a moment as eternity.

page17.text:
"Trace, on. (Begin Projection.)"
Search. Select. Analyze. Project.
That is my role.

page18.text:
This is my second Projection.
Magecraft which erodes my body.
But I can't defeat Saber without it.
Rider can't overcome Saber's Noble Phantasm, not even with Bellerophon.

page19.text:
We both know that.
So I'll help her win.
If Rider's Noble Phantasm lacks destructive power, I just need to make up for it...!

page20.text: "My body is made of swords. (I am the bone of my sword.)"

page21.text:
I've decided what I'll use.
I complete the Projection in an instant.
I'll make Rider win, using the greatest defense Archer knows...

page23.text:
I intone its True Name and turn it into reality!
"Gah!"
I thrust out my left arm, and it shakes.
The nerves, muscles, and blood vessels in it are going haywire.
It feels like it could snap at any second, and I desperately stabilize it with my right hand.

page24.text:
"Nnrgh! Ah, ah, ahhh...!"
Endure it.
I can't stop the Projection yet.
The two pillars of light are still pushing against each other.
If I lose Aias' Protection here,
Rider will be vaporized!

page25.text:
"Geeeh.... AH,        ,  ...!"
My flailing left arm and left shoulder fire bullets into my body.
Uncontrollable magical energy rips around inside my body,
like someone going wild with a rubber eraser,
scrubbing Shirou Emiya's insides blank.

page26.text:
"  , —  ,                                                                                                                          !!!"
I howl.
I scream to drive off the pain and terror of losing myself.

page27.text:
Raw magical power clashes.
It completely upsets the rivalry between the two powers.
"Ah, AaaAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!!"
Four petals scatter the black light,
flooding the cavern in blinding radiance.

page28.text:
The Servants are sent flying apart.
Rider slams into a wall unprotected, with the same speed as her charge.
Saber is blown away by Bellerophon's light, and falls to the ground on her back.

page29.text:
They're both still alive.
Rider's down, unable to stand. She might be out of magical energy.
Meanwhile, Saber...is on the verge of defeat, but she still has strength to spare.

page30.text:
"......Rrgh."
We just barely edged Saber out in the battle of Noble Phantasms.
Ninety percent of Bellerophon's light was cancelled out by Saber's sacred sword.

page31.text:
"...Oh."
I run.
I run without even knowing what I'm supposed to do.
As I run, I unsheathe the Azoth Blade.

page32.text:
"Sa...ber..."
I rush to her.
I rush—I rush to Saber and lean over her helpless body.

page33.text:
"Ah... Shirou...?"
Did she hit her head?
Saber gazes up at me absently.

page34.text:
"...Oh."
I wonder what I look like in her eyes.
I straddle her, raise the dagger, and look down at Saber.
